receivers.reciprocity_dual_large_sieve: same operator norm and same K+Q envelope after finite local refinement
receivers.known_sparse_additive_moduli_after_gauss: conditional on AP-distribution parameter X_AP: Lambda_R^2 is dominated by a Baier-type additive sparse-moduli bound; this is not a direct sparse quadratic theorem

sparse_support_decision.countermodel: For any finite odd row-prime set P, choose arbitrarily many distinct primes q_j congruent 1 mod 8*prod(P). Taking kappa_j=q_j gives E_kappa=N_kappa and chi_{D(kappa_j)}(p)=1 for every p in P, so the character matrix is all ones and Lambda^2=N_ell*N_kappa.
sparse_support_decision.known_sparse_additive_moduli_requirement: quantitative distribution of the selected moduli in arithmetic progressions
required_stage14_specific_structure: prime-character second moment on the actual product-character support
a disjoint structural decomposition on which one of these certificates is provable

preferred_new_theorem.name: Stage14-specific sparse squareclass quadratic large sieve
preferred_new_theorem.statement: sum_{ell in L_R(Q)} |sum_{kappa in K_R} b_kappa chi_{D(kappa)}(ell)|^2 << B^o(1)*(N_ell+N_kappa)*sum_kappa |b_kappa|^2
preferred_new_theorem.alternative_contract: prove the weighted product-character dispersion receiver strong enough to improve the critical exponent ledger

critical_strip_ledger.known_sparse_additive_route_min_operator: at least 17/4 when X_AP=B^o(1) and beta=0
